args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. It was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was skipped because it was only healthy in staging. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs to be found before it is redeployed.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- **After:** All three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** It describes the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 and why v2.3.1-rc was skipped. It also notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs to be found before it's redeployed.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging).
